integrity: One analytical theorem and its associated METD1 comparison; explicit proof, exact finite rational inequality and a standard-library numerical verifier are included. Finite checks are not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic unit-step Lyapunov equation with two real negative diagonal rates, rank-one constant source, and zero initial covariance.
The spectral conclusion concerns the symmetric part of the METD2/METD2RK output, not convergence under mesh refinement at fixed operator.
No independent verification or exhaustive publication-priority search is claimed.
title: Unbounded covariance negativity in second-order matrix exponential time differencing
